title: The Downloads widget's poster cache grows without bound in one AsyncStorage row (every downloadId ever seen in the queue or the last 50 history rows), and every storage write is fire-and-forget with no error handling; on Android a row past the 2 MB cursor window breaks initStorage and so hydrate, and a full store makes later saves fail silently
where: hooks/use-torrent-poster-map.ts:22-44, :89-113 (additive, never evicted, persisted as one JSON value), store/storage.ts:7-13 (initStorage multiGet of every key), :21-24, :70-74 (AsyncStorage promises dropped, no catch)
smell: A 'sticky' cache keyed by an unbounded id space, persisted whole, with no cap or eviction; writes whose promise is never awaited
repro: reading only; the size at which it breaks was not measured (about 300 bytes per entry, so roughly 7,000 distinct downloads for 2 MB)
